+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Limited-mode, camera-based screwdriver pickup controller.

+    im = obs.last[camera].astype(float)

+    gray = im.mean(axis=2)
+    sat = im.max(axis=2) - im.min(axis=2)

+    else:

+    b = d[mask]
+    coef = np.linalg.lstsq(A, b, rcond=None)[0]
+    for _ in range(5):
